sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, 'Stickman Army: The Defenders' is a strategy game that requires players to think critically and make tough decisions. This energy system adds a whole new layer of strategy to the game, as players must carefully balance their unit deployment with their energy levels.

The game's combat system is also noteworthy, with units able to move and attack in a variety of ways. Players can issue commands to units to move to specific locations, attack enemies, or defend against incoming attacks. The game's AI is also impressive, with enemies adapting to the player's strategy and presenting a challenge that's both fun and formidable.

One of the game's greatest strengths is its diversity in units. With over 40 units to unlock, players have access to a vast array of soldiers, each with their own unique characteristics.
